messages.content:
You must use the update_reminder tool exactly once now.
Do not answer in text. Do not explain. Emit one tool call with these exact arguments:
{
  "reminder_id": "test-reminder-id-1234",
  "title": "",
  "notes": "",
  "due_date": "",
  "list_name": "",
  "priority": -1,
  "clear_notes": true,
  "clear_due_date": false,
  "clear_priority": true
}
Empty string means exactly two quote characters with no spaces between them.
Do not put a space inside title, notes, due_date, or list_name.
Emit the tool call and stop.

function.description: Update an existing reminder. Use query_reminders first to obtain the reminder_id. To leave a field unchanged, pass empty string (or -1 for priority) and false for the matching clear_* flag. To clear a field back to empty, set the matching clear_* flag to true and pass empty string (or -1 for priority) for the value. Sending both a non-empty value and clear_*=true on the same field is rejected. list_name has no clear flag because every reminder must live in some list. All dates are ISO 8601 UTC.
function.name: update_reminder

clear_due_date.description: Set true to remove the existing due date. Cannot be combined with a non-empty due_date.

clear_notes.description: Set true to remove existing notes. Cannot be combined with a non-empty notes value.

clear_priority.description: Set true to clear priority back to none (0). Cannot be combined with a priority >= 0.

due_date.description: New due date in ISO 8601 UTC (yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'). Pass empty string to leave unchanged.

list_name.description: Move to this Reminders list by name. Pass empty string to leave unchanged. The list must already exist.

notes.description: New notes. Pass empty string to leave unchanged.

priority.description: New priority (0 = none, 1 = high, 5 = medium, 9 = low). Pass -1 to leave unchanged.

reminder_id.description: calendarItemIdentifier of the reminder, from query_reminders.

title.description: New title. Pass empty string to leave unchanged.
